lines: The app ships no composer/autoload.php, so the server registers its generic loader for lib/ and looks every class up in the file system.

A composer/composer.json with config.vendor-dir ".", config.optimize-autoloader true, a config.autoloader-suffix and autoload.psr-4 {"OCA\\ProjectManager\\": "../lib/"} makes composer dump-autoload write composer/autoload.php with a class map; the code of the app does not change.

phpunit/phpunit is in require-dev of composer.json. The manual recommends a vendor-bin/ of bamarni/composer-bin-plugin per tool, so that the dependencies of a tool cannot conflict with those of the app.
lib/ reads the clock directly in 6 places. OCP\AppFramework\Utility\ITimeFactory, a PSR-20 ClockInterface, gives the same time and can be replaced in a test.
Nothing in the app calls 38 OCS routes. OCS is there for clients outside the app, so this is no defect in itself.
